title: Coca-Cola — Global Visual Directions
jpTitle: Coca-Cola — グローバルビジュアルディレクション
organization: The Coca-Cola Company (via Ogilvy Brand Integration Group)
role: Senior Designer, Ogilvy Brand Integration Group
summary: As Senior Designer at Ogilvy's Brand Integration Group, developed two parallel global visual directions for Coca-Cola: 'Coke-Animal World,' whimsical creatures built from bottle silhouettes including a giant-swan Times Square billboard, and 'SketchVibe World,' a hand-sketched aesthetic — deployed across billboards, vehicles, packaging, coolers and stationery internationally.

angles.creative: Two coherent illustration systems — animal forms built from the bottle silhouette, and a hand-sketched mark — designed to flex across formats as different as a Times Square billboard and a sheet of letterhead.

mine: Developed two parallel global visual directions at Ogilvy's Brand Integration Group
Direction 1 'Coke-Animal World': whimsical creatures built from Coke bottle silhouettes, including a giant swan billboard in Times Square, deployed on billboards, buses and coolers
Direction 2 'SketchVibe World': a hand-sketched aesthetic applied to cans, letterhead, wall murals, transit lightboxes, coolers and vehicle wraps
Created the illustration systems behind both directions
Designed applications across consumer touchpoints — billboards, vehicles, packaging, environment, stationery
team: Not separated on the source page — team scope to be confirmed. The page credits the Ogilvy Brand Integration Group and notes guidance from VP of Design David Butler.
